Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring county auditors to place ballot drop boxes at various locations throughout the county.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to placement of ballot drop boxes; and adding a newsection to chapter 29A.40 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.40 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: County auditors must place ballot drop boxes at various locationsthroughout the county. Ballot drop boxes may be placed inside abuilding or outdoors. At a minimum, ballot drop boxes must be placedat the following locations: (1) Institutions of higher education at a ratio of one drop box forevery three thousand students; (2) School district headquarters; and (3) High schools. County auditors must consider locating ballot drop boxes atshopping malls; state, city, and county offices; private buildings; andother sites considered to be convenient locations.
